item.title: Kerry Experience Has Driven Cromane’s Confidence
item.description: Cromane manager Anna Maria O'Donoghue says being part of the Kerry setup in recent seasons has given her players the confidence required at All-Ireland level. Cromane are preparing to face Leinster champions Muckalee in the AIB Ladies All-Ireland Junior Club Football Championship Final. O'Donoghue told Radio Kerry’s Breda O'Shea that the experience and standards gained inside the Kerry camp have been invaluable. item.title: Slot Refuses to Confirm Mo Salah’s Future at Liverpool
item.description: Liverpool manager Arne Slot has refused to comment on Mo Salah’s long-term future at the club. Salah was not part of the squad for last night’s win over Inter Milan, having criticised the club after the weekend draw with Leeds. It remains unclear whether he will feature against Brighton on Saturday — Liverpool’s final game before he departs for the Africa Cup of Nations. Speaking at the San Siro, Slot said the focus should remain on the players who delivered the three points. Advertisement

item.title: Jury begins deliberations in mid Kerry murder trial
item.description: The jury has begun its deliberations in the trial of an ex-soldier accused of murdering a Kerry pensioner. Thomas Carroll, with an address at Brookway, Clonmel, Co Tipperary faces one charge before Mr Justice Patrick McGrath at the Central Criminal Court in Limerick. He’s accused of murdering 84-year-old Paddy O’Mahony on February 24th 2024 at Ballyreameen, near Castlemaine. item.title: Over 90% had good to very good experience of maternity care at UHK
item.description: Over 90% of respondents to a survey who gave birth at UHK had a good to very good overall experience of maternity care. That’s according to the second National Maternity Experience Survey, analysing the care in Ireland’s 19 maternity hospitals and units, and at home. Advertisement UHK received a higher percentage of good to very good responses than the national average. item.title: North Kerry food business served with closure order for food safety breaches
item.description: A North Kerry food business was served with a closure order in November for breaches of food safety legislation. A spokesperson for McHale Party Hire Ltd trading as McHales Catering Base and Stretford End Bar at Drumkeen in Causeway said they had to close for less than a day after the closure order was issued. item.title: Yellow wind warning issued for Kerry overnight
item.description: A yellow wind warning has been issued for Kerry as well as Galway and Mayo. The Met Éireann warning will be valid from midnight tonight seven o'clock (7am) tomorrow morning. The state's meteorological service is forecasting strong and gusty southerly winds, mainly affecting coastal parts. Advertisement There is the potential for difficult travelling conditions, fallen trees and branches, and displaced debris and loose objects.
